data.title: 五河琴里 · 战舰舰桥落日红光的司令官威严
data.description: 空中战舰佛拉克西纳斯指挥舰桥，琴里扎着标志性黑色发带，身披鲜红军官大衣，坐在高耸舰长席上嘴衔珍宝珠棒棒糖，目光如炬俯瞰云海战场。
data.action: 翘起双腿坐在高大指挥椅上，单手支颌，黑发带随风微扬，神态冷峻果决，嘴边咬着棒棒糖塑料棍
data.lighting: 主屏幕与落日红霞将整个科技舰桥染成火红与幽蓝的对比色
data.camera: 低角度仰拍，突出司令官模式下的强大气场与娇小反差
data.promptProse: Kotori Itsuka commands the bridge of the aerial battleship Fraxinus, seated regally within her towering captain's chair as the sunset blazes through panoramic cockpit glass. Draped in her crisp white military commander coat over a red uniform, she ties her fiery red twin-tails with stern black ribbons. Resting her chin upon a fist while biting thoughtfully on a Chupa Chups lollipop, her ruby eyes exude sharp tactical intellect.
data.animaCaption: From the elevated captain's seat of the airship bridge, Commander Kotori twirls her lollipop with cool, authoritative resolve.
